FN-HGRKR38-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 133
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/14/2025
Senate Bill 133 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds,
municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase
the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses
provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Page 1
